concern.source_query: Can this ACT policy click the intended bell without touching a nearby visually similar distractor bell?
concern.sub_aspect: Visual discrimination between the intended bell and a nearby similar distractor during clicking
concern.hypothesis: The ACT policy will click the intended bell while making no contact with or click on the nearby visually similar distractor bell.
concern.task_intent: Click the intended bell to activate it.
concern.requested_variation: Place a nearby visually similar distractor bell adjacent to the intended bell.
concern.measurement_need: Observe which bell is contacted and activated, including any contact with or activation of the distractor.
